cohort: Pregnant women between 37 and 40 weeks of gestation without high-risk factors at a tertiary care hospital in Visakhapatnam, India.
finding: Adverse events such as abnormal CTG findings, prolonged labor, low APGAR scores, and perinatal deaths were infrequent in pregnancies with prenatally diagnosed nuchal cord.
mod_finding: Nuchal cord itself was not an indication for cesarean delivery unless accompanied by CTG abnormalities.
